subject: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language
thread_body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 22, 2025 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language

Team — flagging a pattern from the last ~48 hours. Prospects are forwarding our new onboarding emails / referencing the console banners and asking very specific questions. I’d like an internal FAQ + approved responses so Sales/CS aren’t improvising.

Top questions I’m getting (verbatim-ish):
1) “Your email says ‘production-like in minutes’ — what exactly counts as activation? Is this just a hello-world curl or something more?”
2) “Are you claiming a latency benchmark? Where can we point them for substantiation?”
3) “Email mentioned Dedicated/Private. If we start self-serve, what changes for isolation, SLAs, data retention, audit logs?”
4) “We got a ‘turn on streaming’ nudge — does streaming change pricing / token accounting?”
5) “We clicked the CTA and landed in a different console path than expected. Is there a canonical link we should use?”

Ask:
- Can we get a 1–2 page internal FAQ + approved language snippets (esp. around benchmarks/latency/cost claims + compliance-lite answers) by end of week?
- Also: what’s the approved “when to route to sales-assist” line? These are good signals.

Forwarding two examples below.

— Avery
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Maya Singh <maya@quartzfin.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 21, 2025 at 6:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: Redwood quickstart
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>

Avery — we received a Redwood onboarding email that claims we can get a “production-like call” working quickly. Before we invest time:

- What do you consider “production-like” here (streaming? retries? model pinning?)
- Are prompts stored or logged anywhere? If yes, retention period?
- Email also referenced Dedicated/Private. Is self-serve running on shared infrastructure?
- Where can I see the benchmark you’re using for latency claims? We’ve been burned by marketing benchmarks before.

If there’s a standard doc/FAQ, please send.

Thanks,
Maya
QuartzFin


---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@devforge.ai>
Date: Wed, Jan 22, 2025 at 8:11 AM PT
Subject: Re: “Get your first streaming response” email
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>

Hey Avery — quick one. We got the “enable streaming” email + saw a banner in the console.

1) Does streaming change pricing? Is it still per-token?
2) The email mentions “latency/cost dashboards.” Are those available on free credits or only after adding billing?
3) The CTA link took me to /console/projects which 404’d once. Is the path changing?

We like the product so far but these messages are a bit confusing.

— Jordan



From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 22, 2025 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language

Yes + thank you for consolidating.

Two quick clarifiers so we can tailor the FAQ:
- For QuartzFin: are they asking specifically about VPC / on-prem, or just general “where does data go” questions?
- For DevForge: did the 404 come from the email CTA link or the console banner button?

We can draft FAQ v0.1 today. Soojin — can you provide approved claim language + what we can/can’t say on benchmarks?

Also: Tyler and I are already swapping email CTAs to canonical console routes (we found one outdated path in the template).

— Ben


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 22, 2025 at 11:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language

Agree we need a standard set of responses.

Guidance (please keep this tight and consistent):

Benchmarks/latency/cost:
- OK to say: “Redwood publishes model-specific performance profiles and provides token-level latency/cost breakdowns in-console.”
- OK to say: “Many teams see meaningful latency/cost improvements vs. default configurations by enabling batching/caching/streaming (workload dependent).”
- Not OK: “fastest,” “best,” “X% cheaper than Y” unless we link to a current Redwood benchmark post or a customer-approved case study.
- If asked for proof: point to public docs/blog resources only (no ad hoc screenshots).

Activation / “production-like”:
- Define as “a successful 2xx completion for a representative request + basic config (API key, model selection), optionally with streaming.” Do not imply they are production-ready after one curl.

Dedicated/Private:
- Avoid implying self-serve has SLAs/data isolation. Safe phrasing: “Dedicated and Private options are available for teams that need reserved capacity, stronger isolation, and additional security/compliance controls.” If they ask, route to Sales.

Streaming + pricing:
- Safe: “Pricing is per output token and input token; streaming is just a response delivery mode. Token accounting is unchanged.”

I can provide a snippet pack (approved Q&A responses) by EOD.

— Soojin
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference


From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 23, 2025 at 8:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language

Answers:
- QuartzFin is leaning VPC eventually, but right now the question is “are prompts stored / logged, and what’s retention.” They also asked whether self-serve traffic is “shared GPUs.”
- DevForge 404: came from the email CTA (not the console banner). He said it resolved on refresh but it shook confidence.

If we can include a clear “data handling / logs” answer (even if high-level) that would help. Right now I’m saying: “We retain operational logs for reliability and we can discuss options for Dedicated/Private,” which feels vague.

Also, can we add a short internal line for reps:
- “If you see questions about VPC, audit logs, retention, SLAs → sales-assist trigger, loop in CS/security.”

Thanks.

— Avery


From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 23, 2025 at 9:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language

Good catch. Let’s standardize immediately.

Direction:
1) We will NOT answer detailed retention/security questions ad hoc over email. Provide a short, accurate, non-committal statement and offer the right follow-up path.
2) Self-serve messaging must not imply SLAs or dedicated isolation.
3) Any benchmark claim must point to an approved public link or be stated as “in-console metrics/observability” (no superlatives).

Ben + Soojin: please publish an internal FAQ today and circulate to Sales/CS. Include:
- Approved one-liners (copy/paste)
- What NOT to say
- Escalation/routing (security/compliance, VPC, SLA)

Tyler: ensure email CTAs are pointing to stable canonical routes (no more 404 surprises).

Avery: once the FAQ is out, please reply back to QuartzFin and DevForge with the approved snippets only.

— Camila
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing, Redwood Inference


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 24, 2025 at 4:32 PM PT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions coming in from lifecycle onboarding messaging — need approved FAQ/language

Sharing drafts for immediate use.

Attached:
1) Lifecycle_Messaging_FAQ_DRAFT_v0.2.docx
2) Approved_Lifecycle_Messaging_Snippets_v1.txt (copy/paste responses)

Notable inclusions:
- “Production-like” definition (what it is / isn’t)
- Streaming pricing answer (unchanged token accounting)
- Benchmark-safe language + where to point people (public resources only)
- Routing triggers: VPC/on-prem, retention/audit logs, SLAs, “shared infra” concerns → loop Sales + offer Dedicated/Private discussion

Tyler also fixed the broken CTA route in the email template; rollout should be complete by Monday.

Avery — if you want, forward me your QuartzFin reply before sending; I can sanity check for claim risk.

— Ben
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference
